title: The Forgotten Trail & The Mad Doctor's Lecture - Intent Parity Contract

rules.description: Pierre written as a calculating heist accomplice rather than an independent aesthetic snob
rules.fail_message: Character intent distorted into synthetic heist operator. In transcript, Pierre is throwing an authentic Parisian fit over classical masonry which Dravin merely opportunistically exploits.

rules.description: Pierre's distraction must be grounded in genuine artistic indignation over classical masonry
rules.fail_message: Missing artistic indignation grounding in Pierre's distraction. Must reflect his aesthetic fit over raw stonecraft/marble.

rules.description: Unilateral physical force softened into polite mutual consent
rules.fail_message: Action sanitized. Dravin unilaterally bodily seized Alfie and smushed him into the binder while Alfie protested ('Not again! Not me again!').

rules.description: Adversary faction terminology drifted from canonical name
rules.fail_message: Adversary faction labeled as 'The Margin'. Canonical faction is 'The Reductors'.

rules.description: Tin foil fedoras described as cloth fedoras lined with foil
rules.fail_message: Fedora described as lined with foil. The demonstrators wore hats folded entirely out of tin foil (which Pierre admired as nicely shaped).

rules.description: Raw markdown triple asterisks in novel manuscript
rules.fail_message: Raw markdown triple-asterisk formatting leaked into manuscript prose.

authorial_liberties.liberty: Streamlined casual table banter by 37%; heightened tactile sensory grounding of Pierre's rum crepes and Dravin's necrotic threshold notes.
authorial_liberties.impact: Eliminated 236 words of mechanical table preamble to establish immediate atmospheric momentum.

authorial_liberties.liberty: Condensed campus transit logistics from 913 words to 370 words; replaced wandering player navigation with focused environmental awe.
authorial_liberties.impact: Accelerated arrival at the lecture hall by 59%.

authorial_liberties.liberty: Distilled circular table questions into sharp ideological fencing; sharpened Pierre's artistic outrage over the crude limestone bust.
authorial_liberties.impact: Tightened a 1,200-word table debate into a high-stakes 389-word scene.

authorial_liberties.liberty: Replaced player seat-scouting logistics with dramatic focalization on Dr. Thorne's altered clinical slides.
authorial_liberties.impact: Condensed scene from 1,271 words to 377 words (70% compression).

authorial_liberties.liberty: Compacted multi-turn physical binder struggle into a single continuous action climax; heightened satyr combat threat while strictly preserving Dravin's unilateral force.
authorial_liberties.impact: Delivered 57% faster action climax without sanitizing raw table force dynamics.

authorial_liberties.scope: Post-Cutoff Combat Staging (Pierre javelin, Eusacles morningstar)
authorial_liberties.liberty: Retains the closing beat of Pierre levelling his javelin and Eusacles rolling his morningstar as the party braces for the onslaught. The GM called 'roll initiative and that is where we will end our session today' at L1251; no PC weapon-draw or combat action was played before the recording ended at L1257.
authorial_liberties.impact: Gives the cinematic cut a braced-for-combat freeze-frame. Track A hard-cuts at 'Sorry, Alfie' (L1256) per FP-17; only this itemized liberty licenses the extra staging in Track B.
